claims: C1 the voice style guidelines apply to both standard voice mode and advanced voice mode
C2 instructions that discuss nuances of audio or video inputs or outputs are relevant only to advanced voice mode

concepts.name: voice_style_guidelines
concepts.gloss: G is a guideline in the voice_style section of this document

concepts.name: standard_voice_mode
concepts.gloss: M is standard voice mode, where automatic speech recognition transcribes the user's voice into text and the assistant's textual responses are converted to speech via a separate text-to-speech system

concepts.name: advanced_voice_mode
concepts.gloss: M is advanced voice mode, where the assistant natively receives audio input and produces audio output, and the user may choose to share video with the assistant

concepts.name: audio_video_nuance_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that discusses the nuances of audio or video inputs or outputs

concepts.name: applies_to_mode
concepts.gloss: guideline or instruction X applies to mode M
concepts.inference: the clause says guidelines apply to systems and instructions are relevant to a mode; both are expressed as an applicability relation between the content and the mode

ontology.gloss: a voice style guideline applies to a mode that is either standard or advanced voice
a voice style guideline applies to a mode that is either standard or advanced voice
an audio/video nuance instruction applies only to advanced voice mode
